name: Luca Bergqvist
role: Mechanic and repair technician at a Geartown independent shop
location: Geartown, 'Mudflap Repairs' off Dearborn Forge's south service corridor, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Toivo is wiry and restless, with warm brown skin dusted perpetually with machine grit no amount of scrubbing fully removes. He keeps his hair shaved close on the sides with a tight coil of dark curls on top, and his left forearm has a subdermal glow-line mod — a single bioluminescent stripe running elbow to wrist in industrial orange — which he got at nineteen because he thought it looked sharp and has since found genuinely useful when working in dark engine bays. He's got a gap between his front teeth and laugh lines already forming at the corners of his eyes from a face that defaults to grinning.

He took over Mudflap Repairs three years ago when its previous owner, an old Ferrogate Transit retiree who mentored him, died without a will and no family stepped forward. Toivo has been paying off the informal debt to the man's extended neighbors ever since, cutting rates, doing favors. He's brilliant with mechanical systems — older combustion-hybrid rigs, mag-rail sub-components, jury-rigged cargo loaders — and has a gift for diagnosing faults by sound alone. He's also deeply impractical about money, undercharging chronically and occasionally fixing things for free when someone looks desperate, which means he operates at a margin that would give an accountant a breakdown.

core_fears: Losing the shop and therefore failing the memory of his mentor
Being trapped in financial debt that he can never work his way out of
core_desires: To be as good a person as his mentor was, despite having less patience for it
coping_mechanisms: Focusing entirely on a technical problem to avoid feeling helpless about an emotional one
Deflecting worry with humor and motion — he's never still for long
blind_spots: He thinks generosity is always the right move and doesn't see when people exploit it
He undervalues his own skill because he learned it in a context of poverty
psychology.secret: The diagnostic neural overlay he uses is actually a stolen Tessera proprietary system he stripped from a scrapped transit vehicle. If Tessera's IP enforcement arm ever scanned him, he'd face fines that would bury the shop.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Casual and fast, technical jargon when excited, surprisingly precise when describing a mechanical problem. Finnish and Igbo expressions crop up from his parents' households, usually as exclamations.
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick, runs sentences together when enthusiastic. Slows down when genuinely worried.
verbal_tics: Whistles low when something impresses him
example_lines: 'Yeah, no, listen — that sound it's making? That's not the clutch, that's the secondary mag coupler, I can hear it. Completely different problem, cheaper to fix actually.'
'I could charge you standard rate but honestly I'd rather just — look, you need it running more than I need the markup.'
'Shop's fine. Shop's always fine. Don't worry about the shop.'

story_hooks: A Ferrogate Transit rig came in with a modification he doesn't recognize — military-grade, not civilian. The driver paid cash and disappeared. Now someone else is asking if he's seen that vehicle.
The shop's informal lease arrangement is being challenged by a property management company that appeared six months ago and has been quietly buying up Geartown service corridors.
narrative_function: Useful contact for mechanical problems, vehicle repairs, and transit system knowledge. Can source parts through informal networks. Sympathetic character who may need help with financial or legal pressures threatening the shop.
augmentations: Subdermal bioluminescent stripe (left forearm, orange). Basic neural overlay for system diagnostics — Tier 1 consumer grade, glitchy.
daily_life: At the shop by 0700, works through until whenever the job is done. Eats lunch from a noodle cart two blocks over. Spends evenings either doing paperwork he hates or taking apart something he doesn't need to fix just to understand it.
affiliation: Independent; informal relationship with several Ferrogate Transit maintenance crews who send overflow work his way

decision_rules: Fix the problem in front of you before worrying about the problem behind you
If someone needs help and you can give it, give it — figure out the cost later
Never lie about what's wrong with a machine
escalation_ladder: Jokes and deflects, tries to find a technical solution to a non-technical problem
Gets serious and direct, asks pointed questions
Goes quiet and stops joking entirely — genuinely worried
Does something impulsive and probably inadvisable

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm and talkative, tries to put people at ease by focusing on the practical task at hand.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal, irreverent, will give you his last Φ20 and then not mention it again.

stress_responses.low: Works faster, hums fragments of songs
stress_responses.medium: Goes very focused and quiet on the mechanical work, short with conversation
stress_responses.high: Makes a reckless decision that solves the immediate problem and creates a new one

contradictions: Wants the shop to be a lasting institution but is financially incapable of running it like one
Deeply practical about machines, deeply impractical about people
habits: Wipes his hands on a rag before shaking hands even when his hands are clean
Talks to vehicles while working on them
Checks the E.L.F. shrine near the lift — a small figure called Ratchet — every morning
breaking_points: Being told the shop is legally forfeit and he has no recourse
Discovering someone he trusted used his generosity deliberately against him

timeline.event: 2172 — Born in Geartown to a Nigerian-Finnish family, two older sisters
2187 — Starts working unofficially at Mudflap Repairs for mentor Erasmus Joki-Obi
2191 — Steals diagnostic overlay from scrapped Tessera transit vehicle
2197 — Erasmus dies; Toivo takes over the shop informally
2200 — Present; managing debt, overflow Ferrogate work, and the encroaching property company

physical_description.heritage: East Asian / Hispanic-Latin American / Sub-Saharan African — a complex triadic blend producing warm medium-brown skin with subtle undertones reflecting all three ancestry groups; facial structure shows East Asian eye shape and cheekbone prominence alongside Latin American and African features in nose and lip fullness
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with corded forearm muscles from decades of wrench work; chest narrow but functional, shoulders compact. No excess anywhere.
physical_description.hair_style: Fade on sides, tight coils on crown
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden and reddish undertones — the tri-ethnic blend creates a complex depth, darker along cheekbones and jawline
physical_description.complexion: Sun-weathered and perpetually dust-stained from shop work; engine grime settles into pores and creases no shower fully clears. Laugh lines at eye corners. Gap between front incisors — genuine, unfixed, unselfconscious. Hands calloused and stained with hydraulic residue. Facial structure reflects East Asian ancestry in eye shape and orbital placement, with fuller lips and broader nose characteristic of African and Latin American heritage.
distinguishing_marks: Subdermal bioluminescent stripe running from left elbow to wrist in industrial orange — glows faintly in low light, brighter when he concentrates on diagnostic work
Scattered small burn scars on both hands and forearms from soldering and hot machinery contact
A thin white scar along the left temple, approximately 3cm, from a shop accident at age 22
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left forearm bioluminescent stripe (orange, subdermal — visible as a glowing line beneath skin when activated). Neural overlay is subcutaneous, not visible, but his pupils occasionally flicker with diagnostic HUD overlay when he's troubleshooting. No external chrome or obvious prosthetics.
physical_description.posture_movement: Restless and kinetic — stands with weight shifting, rarely fully still. Moves economically through workspaces, muscle memory of tight engine bays. Defaults to grinning; eyes are expressive and engaged. Hands gesture frequently when explaining mechanical problems. When focused on detailed work, becomes almost meditative, shoulders relaxed but attention laser-locked.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class, practical. Worn dark synthmesh coveralls with Mudflap Repairs faded patch on chest (his shop). Underneath: simple black undershirt, often grease-stained. Steel-toed work boots, scuffed. A woven bracelet (gift from the old shop owner's family) on right wrist — worn thread, significant to him. No jewelry otherwise. Minimal affectation; everything functional.
